caseName: Jay Burns Baking Co. v. McKelvie
caseNameFull: Jay Burns Baking Company v. Samuel R. McKelvie, as Governor of the State of Nebraska
attorneys: Mr. Matthew A. Hall and Mr. Carrol S. Montgomery lor plaintiffs in error. No appearance for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Motion to substitute the new governor, Charles W. Bryan, for the ex-governor, Samuel R. McKelvie, and to substitute the new secretary of the department of agriculture, Grant Shumway, for the ex-secretary, Leo B. Stuhr, is granted on the ground that such substitution is authorized by § 8546, Comp. Stats. Neb. 1922, as construed and applied by the Supreme Court of Nebraska.
